evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a highly scalable, multilingual alternative that requires no task-specific training, yet the impact of advanced prompting strategies on their performance remains underexplored.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: By comprehensively comparing these approaches against traditional unsupervised metrics and state-of-the-art supervised baselines, we establish the viability of out-of-the-box LLMs as robust, cross-lingual readability assessors.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Furthermore, our exploration of few-shot in-context learning reveals that providing just one labelled example per category (1-shot) substantially enhances prediction quality compared to zero-shot settings, with additional examples offering diminishing returns.
